tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Free-text search across the live catalogue. Matches listing name, description, category and provider name. Returns settlement-verified listings only unless verified_only is false. Free and read-only; spends nothing. Call tracked_url when a listing includes it. That is the URL to call. It is the PayA

tools.name: list_apis
tools.description: Browse the live catalogue, optionally filtered to one category. Omit category for everything. Returns settlement-verified listings only unless verified_only is false. Free and read-only; spends nothing. Call tracked_url when a listing includes it. That is the URL to call. It is the PayAPI path to th

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Fetch a single live listing by its id or slug, including base_url, price range, network and verification state. payment_verified is true if at least one route was paid; verified_routes names each paid route with its on-chain receipt. test_payment_usdc is the test payment, not the per-call price. amo

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: List one or more APIs. The minimum is a paid URL (url, paid_route_url, or urls) and contact_email (email is accepted as the same field). Price, payTo, network, description and name are read from the HTTP 402 when you omit them. Category defaults to Data, which the listing schema accepts. urls takes

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search AI agents by business sector, name, or description. Agents are AI services that perform tasks like lead generation, data enrichment, or automation. Returns agents with their sector, pricing, and verified status. Free and read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_apis, list_apis, get_api, submit_listing · Private data: submit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_apis, list_apis, get_api, submit_listing · Private data: submit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_apis" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
